public_rationale: The antecedent is unknown. Ramp documents concentrated business spending, which is different from showing that unprofitable AI startups supply around 80% of each company's total revenue. Under the conditional-forecast rule, the prediction cannot be scored until that premise is established. No decisive collapse event was found either.
limitations: The available spending sample does not cover all recognized revenue.
The collapse threshold and deadline are unspecified.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Because unprofitable AI startups make up around 80% of Anthropic and OpenAI revenues, the bottom will eventually fall out from both companies.
conditions: because unprofitable AI startups make up ~80% of their revenues

statement.excerpt: AI startups require too much money, are all unprofitable, and make up around 80% of Anthropic and OpenAI’s revenues, meaning that the bottom will eventually fall out from both of them at some indeterminate time.

from_speaker: around 80% of Anthropic and OpenAI’s revenues
the bottom will eventually fall out from both
our_interpretation: The antecedent requires approximately 80% of each company's total revenue to come from unprofitable AI startups.
Customer concentration, enterprise spending and usage-based revenue are different measures from revenue attributable to unprofitable AI startups.
The bottom falling out means a severe, sustained collapse in revenue or business viability caused by those customers failing or cutting purchases.
Because the supplied claim is conditional, the forecast is scored only after its revenue-dependence premise is established.
No numerical tolerance for around 80%, or collapse threshold, is added.
criteria.support_condition: After establishing the stated dependence for both companies, records show a severe and sustained collapse at both attributable to failures or spending cuts among those startup customers.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After establishing the antecedent, definitive evidence shows at least one company permanently escaped that dependence and remained viable through the alleged customer-failure mechanism, or completed a solvent wind-down without the predicted collapse.
